value.rationale: The exact complete idempotent word-map fibers in a canonical character-table family settle more than a single enumeration: every target and every length is counted, idempotent width is sharp, and the stochastic product law has an arithmetic mixing exponent determined by maximal cyclic primary factors. The perfect pairing is natural and structurally distinguished; neither the range of groups nor the arity is an arbitrary slice.
